notes.title: Swingularity 1.0.2 - Patch notes for 25th of March, 10:00PM AEDT
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We hope you're enjoying Swingularity so far! This patch addresses various bugs and improvements based on your feedback. Here’s what’s changed:

[list]
[*] Renamed "Customise" to "Cosmetics" in the main menu for clarity
[*] Players can now cancel aiming by pressing 'R'
[*] Slowed down TIIGER's typing speed by 15%
[*] The "Stylish" achievement no longer unlocks when equipping default items
[*] Added a Reset button to the Point Card, allowing players to restart the galaxy
[*] Fixed an issue where dragging was restricted by the screen edges
[*] Adjusted credits scrolling to function correctly
[*] The Astronaut should no longer spawn with incorrect rotation
[*] Made locks in the Cosmetics screen slightly transparent for better visibility
[/list]

If you run into any more issues, please let us know through our bug report form:
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdocs.google.com%2Fforms%2Fd%2Fe%2F1FAIpQLScvM820uacSDDXKUMUaJZ-Qmpk4h2fbHFIB8-o0U6Q5VZdqNw%2Fviewform]Swingularity Bug Report Form[/url]

Thanks for playing, and happy golfing! 🪐

notes.title: Patch notes for 14th of March, 4:00PM AEDT
notes.content:
Hi golfers!

A small patch is here to address a couple of issues:

[list]
[*] temporarily removed TIIGER dialogue on the final Mythical level
[*] perfectionist achievement is now limited to only the home universe
[/list]
A larger patch will go live later to reimplement the TIIGER dialogue and fix additional minor bugs. If you come across any issues, please report them using our form: [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScvM820uacSDDXKUMUaJZ-Qmpk4h2fbHFIB8-o0U6Q5VZdqNw/viewform]Swingularity Bug Report Form[/url]

Happy golfing! 🪐

notes.title: Swingularity 1.0 Release
notes.content:
[b]Swingularity 1.0[/b] is finally here! Pick up your drivers and get ready for an unique space golf adventure 🚀. The game releases in the morning on March 12th.  A 33% off launch discount is applied for 1 week, so get on it! Additionally, all proceeds will be donated to charity at [b]Project Kindness[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45249706/6fc363ae64090836f1afaed29bdfe4d51a83f600.gif[/img]

The game will be releasing with 4 unqiue hand-crafted universes, each holding approximately 30 different holes. From insanely challenging courses to space-time folding in on itself, you're guarenteed a constantly evolving experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45249706/92e3244f9deb8c97d41229959f8cd7aa04ad2490.gif[/img]

Yet, that's not all, as you'll also have access to a procedurally generated multiverse for infinitely replayability. Progressing through these universes will provide star coins to unlock cosmetics. There are over 30 different hats, trails, and skins to choose from, offering over a 1000 different combinations!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45249706/a0562da1978d30be0f22c21763582abe9942e4d6.gif[/img]

We hope you enjoy [b]Swingularity's[/b] release! You can look forward to consistent updates in the future with even more content. And don't forget to leave a positive review! ːsteamthumbsupː

If you find any bugs, please submit it to our report form here: [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScvM820uacSDDXKUMUaJZ-Qmpk4h2fbHFIB8-o0U6Q5VZdqNw/viewform?usp=header]Swingularity Bug Report Form[/url]
